newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber names Johnston muni research director.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber names Johnston muni research director.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc said Friday it named Michael Johnston, formerly an associate director at Sandler O'Neill & Partners LP, a first vice president and director of municipal research, effective Jan 22.

Johnston will head the Municipal Securities Group's research team and focus on providing research support to investment executives in PaineWebber's four regional divisions, the firm said in a statement.
Johnston will report to William Jester Jr., managing director and manager of the municipal bond department.

At Sandler O'Neill, Johnston was responsible for muni investment banking operations, marketing, and research. Before that, he was vice president and manager of municipal research with Kidder, Peabody & Co.
Johnston was also a former vice president with Moody's Investors Service Inc, where he was assistant director and manager of the Northeast regional ratings group.
